div.div: Solid line = a request or data flow. Orange = a call into the engine, by a rule's name. Dashed purple = the AI narrative (webapp calls both agents' HTTP wrappers, not MCP). Dashed grey = a hand-off outside the request path (the promoted model). Dashed border = runs in-process, not as its own container. Nine services: webapp, planning-service, db, nav-log-agent, crewai-agent, airflow, pipeline-processing, pipeline-training, ml.
